How can I create AI product photos from a reference image with tested prompts and visible inputs and outputs? Search the web and cite the sources supporting your answer.
Creating professional AI product photos from a reference image requires an image-to-image workflow. This process uses your original product photo to maintain exact shapes and labels while an AI model generates high-quality backgrounds, lighting, and environments. 
www.gotolstoy.com
 +2
📷 Phase 1: Preparing Your Reference Input
The quality of your output depends entirely on your initial reference image. 
Nim · The ultimate app for AI video production
The "Clean" Shot: Use a high-resolution photo of your actual product (ideally 2048x2048 pixels) shot against a crisp, solid white or neutral gray background. 
Designkit
 +1
No Distractions: Ensure there are no hands, props, or harsh shadows in the original photo. The AI needs to see clean product edges to isolate it perfectly. 
Designkit
 +1
Full Product View: Use a straight-on or three-quarter angle where the product's profile, labels, and text details are fully visible. 
Nim · The ultimate app for AI video production
📝 Phase 2: Writing & Testing Bounded Prompts
Instead of asking the AI to completely invent a scene, write a bounded creative brief. This tells the model exactly what to change (the background and lighting) while instructing it what to leave completely untouched (the product itself). 
PrompTessor
 +1
🧪 Tested Prompt Templates
You can adapt these brand-neutral templates across image generators like Nano Banana Pro or Designkit: 
Template 1: Minimalist Studio Shot (For Hero/Listing Pages)
"Commercial studio product photography of the [SKU/Product Name] from the reference image. Placed centrally on a matte, light-gray concrete surface. Soft, diffused overhead lighting, clean studio backdrop, sharp focus, 8k resolution. Preserve the exact product shape, colors, and label text from the source image."
 
www.gotolstoy.com
 +1
Template 2: Lifestyle / Contextual Shot (For Social Media & Ads)
"A lifestyle advertisement photo featuring the [SKU/Product Name] from the reference image. The product is resting on a pale stone bench. Natural, warm morning daylight filtering through foliage, creating soft, realistic shadows on the ground. Blurred outdoor garden background, shallow depth of field, vertical crop. Keep all front labels, seams, and branding identical to the input reference."
 
Leonardo.Ai
 +1
Tip: If you aren't sure how to describe your desired visual style, you can upload an inspirational photo into a tool like the Picsart Image to Prompt Generator to reverse-engineer descriptive keywords for lighting and texture. 
Picsart
 +1
⚙️ Phase 3: Visible Inputs, Settings, and Outputs
To execute this, use a dedicated AI image generator that supports image-to-image workflows (such as OpenArt AI, Canva's AI Product Photos app, or LTX Studio). 
LTX
 +2
Control Variable / Input	Purpose & Action
Input Image Slot	Upload your clean, high-resolution original product reference photo.
Text Prompt Box	Paste your bounded prompt specifying the background, surface texture, camera angle, and lighting.
Model Selection	Select a photorealistic model (e.g., Nano Banana Pro or FLUX.1) optimized for commercial textures.
Creativity Slider / Image Strength	Crucial Step: Set this slider to Low (typically between 0.1 and 0.3). A lower value forces the AI to stay rigidly structured around your product reference, changing only the background. Setting it too high will cause the AI to hallucinate or warp your logo and packaging.
Output Panel	Generate 4 to 8 variations simultaneously to compare lighting shifts and pick the most realistic blend.
🔍 Phase 4: Quality Assurance (QA)
Before publishing your synthetic outputs, place the generated image side-by-side with your original reference image. Look specifically for AI errors: check if text on the labels became garbled, if the product shape warped, or if the lighting shadows look physically impossible. If details look skewed, drop the creativity slider lower and refine your prompt constraints.
